summary: Odświeżanie konfiguracji endpointów po zmianie DNS lub IP

delivery.outcome: FixOsConfig automatically observes DNS-backed provider endpoints, reports address changes and preserves the last known in-process observation during transient DNS failures without rewriting secrets or replacing hostnames with IP literals.
nonGoals: No external DNS, Plesk or server mutation.
No API key, endpoint cache or other persistent data.
No health-check requests or public API compatibility break.

architecture.decision: Resolve the configured URL hostname at configuration-load time and retain only a process-local observation. Keep the configured hostname as the client URL so DNS changes are picked up by the network stack and TLS identity is preserved; use stale observations only for diagnostics when DNS is temporarily unavailable.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; existing endpoint environment variables and client URL behavior remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: 7 focused tests passed; Ruff and compileall passed.
Governance remains blocked by GOV-INTENT-003 because intent.json was not committed before the first implementation commit; the current pytest run recorded 603 passed, 5 skipped and 16 deselected.
